summary: Spike in outbound data access after atypical auth event for svc_account_analytics
description:
Issue summary: On 2026-03-13 at ~09:17 UTC the monitoring alert 'high-outbound-rows' triggered for the analytics service account (svc_account_analytics). Impact: potential unauthorized exfiltration of customer telemetry and internal logs. Initial detection came from the data-exfil monitor and correlated with an unusual interactive login event for the same identity.

Timeline (brief): 2026-03-13 09:10 UTC - Phishing report received in #sec-phish-triage referencing suspicious email to two employees. 2026-03-13 09:16 UTC - Alert: abnormal outbound row count from analytics cluster. 09:17 UTC - Auth logs show interactive token exchange for svc_account_analytics from an unfamiliar IP (AS 40123, geo: Eastern Europe). 09:22 UTC - Automated rule triggered to snapshot and throttle the account. 09:30 UTC - Support/Oncall engaged.

Initial hypothesis: A targeted spear-phishing email led to credential capture (either user-level or service account token reuse) which allowed access to the analytics service account or credentials with data-read scope. Alternative hypotheses: compromised CI/CD secret, lateral movement from a compromised dev laptop, or misconfigured automation.

Immediate impact: Sensitive telemetry and internal logs may have been read and partially exported (exact volume under investigation). No confirmed public disclosure. No production compute jobs affected beyond data access throttling.

Action requested: Full SRE+Security triage, token/key rotation for the svc_account_analytics, freeze and snapshot of affected buckets, mail quarantine for reported phishing messages, and forensic capture of auth and egress logs.
steps_to_reproduce: N/A - security incident; not reproducible on demand
If attempting validation: query auth logs for principal svc_account_analytics between 2026-03-13T09:00Z and 2026-03-13T10:00Z
Query data egress logs for any exports initiated by principal with ID 'svc_account_analytics' in same timeframe
logs: auth.log snippet: 2026-03-13T09:16:21Z LOGIN interactive principal=svc_account_analytics src_ip=185.98.210.42 user_agent=okta/1.0 scope=data_read token_id=tok-84f3
alert: high-outbound-rows triggered rule=data-exfil threshold=100000 observed=124812
investigation: 09:25 - Ran ipinfo lookup for 185.98.210.42 -> AS40123, previously unseen in our allowlist
09:27 - Confirmed the interactive login originated via SSO exchange; Okta session ID okta-sess-77 observed
09:45 - Cross-checked CI pipeline secrets: no recent changes to pipeline that use svc_account_analytics key (PRs since 2026-02-28)
10:10 - Mail team quarantined two messages reported in #sec-phish-triage; subject lines reference 'invoice' and contained link to external storage domain suspected of hosting credential harvester
10:55 - Rotated API tokens for svc_account_analytics and invalidated active sessions; temporarily disabled programmatic access pending further review
comments: Miguel Torres (SRE) 2026-03-13 09:35: "Taking lead on immediate mitigation: revoking tokens and throttling outbound from analytics cluster."
Lina Chen (Security) 2026-03-13 09:40: "Quarantine copies of the two reported emails saved to secure evidence store; forwarding to DFIR team."
Priya Kapoor (Assignee) 2026-03-13 10:05: "Rotated keys and created temporary deny policy for any principals originating from AS40123. Need forensics to confirm exfil target list."
Aisha Patel (Reporter) 2026-03-13 10:20: "Customer-facing comms hold: no external notification until we have confirmation of data types accessed."
mitigations_applied: Rotated service account keys for svc_account_analytics
Invalidated all associated Okta sessions and revoked refresh tokens
Applied egress throttle and temporary deny policy for IP ranges observed
Quarantined reported phishing emails and blocklisted sender domains
Snapshot of affected S3 buckets and logs stored in secure evidence bucket
next_steps: DFIR full image capture of affected instances and network taps
Deep scan of CI/CD pipelines for leaked secrets
Work with Legal for potential breach notification scoping if PII confirmed
Run retroactive query to enumerate all read operations by principal since 2026-03-01
Finalize post-incident report and update phishing runbook with indicators of compromise
resolution: Mitigations applied and containment in progress; full forensic analysis pending. No customer notification required at this time per Legal, pending findings. Postmortem to be scheduled after DFIR completes evidence review.
